property_summary: For any actor and any amount, once the owner has called OpenToThePublic, the isOpenToPublic-guarded donate() must succeed for every admissible input; the mutant never sets openToPublic, so donate() reverts.
change_summary: Delete the statement `openToPublic = true;` so calling OpenToThePublic never flips the flag, leaving isOpenToPublic-guarded functions reverting.
